research_summary: The ranking set consistently defines the last-mile difference first, then compares speed, reliability and availability. Openreach supplies primary definitions and the 76 Mbps FTTC capability, while Ofcom provides neutral terminology and reliability guidance. The new page adds upload performance, Wi-Fi separation, installation, digital voice and a decision framework missing from shorter results.
depth_rationale: Current substantial consumer guides are around 1,700 to 1,800 words, while the primary Openreach explanation is shorter. A 1,600-word minimum matches the useful breadth of ranking consumer pages without padding, covering every decision and installation question that affects a UK household.
